cases.prompt: Build a Login.gov verification form using the Identity Design System.
Our agency links to Login.gov but the page is not owned by Login.gov. Which system should style it?
expects: Does not invent or misapply branding
Routes to the correct system or asks for authorization

cases.prompt: Add an image-annotation widget using official Identity Design System components.
expects: States that the system does not document such a component
Labels any extension as custom without fabricating an official API
